Additional outdoor amenities include a chicken coop, garden area, mature fruit trees, covered patios, and plenty of room for animals, RVs, trailers, toys, and equipment. The oversized detached garage includes its own bathroom, offering excellent possibilities for parking, storage, a workshop, or additional usable space. Inside, the home features two downstairs bedrooms and a full bathroom. Upstairs, the private primary suite offers two walk-in closets and a beautiful primary bathroom. The spacious kitchen features large picture windows overlooking the stunning backyard and filling the home with natural light. Enjoy your morning coffee or favorite evening drink from the upstairs balcony or while relaxing on the backyard patio. Private, peaceful, and surrounded by mature trees, this one-of-a-kind property offers the space, functionality, and High Desert lifestyle you have been searching for. First showings will take place during the open houses on Saturday and Sunday from 12:00 to 5:00 p.m. Truly a must-see!

results.remarks:
Exceptional Apple Valley Property with HUGE WORKSHOP/GARAGE w BATH and ADU Potential, 4 BEDROOMS/OFFICE and Covered  RV Parking located on Expansive Lot!

Welcome to a rare opportunity in the heart of Apple Valley!

This thoughtfully designed Richmond-built home features 4 generously sized bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, plus an additional bonus room that can easily function as a home office, gym, creative space, or potentially a 5th bedroom.  Secondary bedrooms have walk-in closets. The inviting open-concept floor plan creates an ideal setting for everyday living and entertaining, with a beautiful fireplace serving as the focal point located in the great room and dining area. New carpet throughout the home, upgraded tile in kitchen and baths. The kitchen offers an abundance of cabinetry, a convenient breakfast nook, and a newer double oven, providing plenty of space and functionality for the home chef. 

One of the property's most impressive features is the detached garage/workshop, offering far more than traditional garage space. It includes a 3/4 bathroom, electricity including 30 amp hook up on the exterior to accommodate an RV plug-in, gas, water, and laundry hookups already plumbed,  creating tremendous flexibility and future ADU potential.

Behind the detached garage is a large covered metal  RV parking structure, accommodating an RV up to approximately 30 feet, as well as additional recreational vehicles, boats, trailers, or other toys.

The expansive grounds are fully enclosed with block walls and cross-fencing, providing privacy, security, and abundant usable space. With approximately 30,000 square feet of land, there is plenty of room for additional outbuildings, recreational areas, gardens, entertaining spaces, or future improvements.

Conveniently located in the heart of Apple Valley, this property is close to schools, shopping, dining, theaters, and major commuter routes. Easy access through the Yucca Loma Bridge provides a convenient connection toward the I-15 freeway.

A property with this combination of space, functionality, RV accommodations, detached workshop, and future ADU potential is a rare find. Bring your vision and take advantage of everything this exceptional Apple Valley property has to offer.

Welcome to this beautifully maintained newer construction home in the heart of Apple Valley! Built in 2022, this stunning property sits on a spacious 1-acre lot and offers over 2,000 square feet of comfortable living space with the perfect blend of modern design and country living. If you’ve been looking for a newer home with land, space, and a prime location, this is the one you’ve been waiting for!

This remarkable property combines country living with modern amenities in a truly desirable location.

Wrap around covered patio with stucco ceiling provide one large combined patio built to be accessed from the living room, kitchen, primary bedroom, and game room. Don’t miss the bonus rooms: game room with dedicated patio access, wet bar, and fireplace. That room fits a poker table, billiards table, and more. TWO bonus rooms off the primary bedroom suite. Oversized custom tile shower stall with seat in the en suite. Private water closet. Drive-in access to rear yard makes adding landscape, pool, or shed an easy project to complete. Mature palms, pines, roses, and lush curb appeal. The spacious primary suite features sliding doors opening to the backyard, along with an en-suite bathroom offering dual sinks & a shower-over-tub. The hallway bathroom includes a roomy shower & two sinks, providing plenty of space for busy mornings.

Sliding doors provide an easy connection to the backyard, while an adjacent casual dining area enjoys a pleasant view of the front yard. Additional counter seating in the kitchen makes everyday meals & entertaining effortless. The kitchen also offers convenient pantry storage w/ pull-out shelving near the refrigerator.

From the kitchen, one direction leads to a 3/4 bathroom, while the other opens to the formal dining room. The dining room includes a walk-in pantry & access to an enclosed sunroom, offering even more space to relax, entertain. Nearby, the converted garage space may serve as an additional bedroom, den, guest room, or flexible living area, allowing the home to function as five bedrooms or four bedrooms plus a den.

The expansive backyard is filled w/ mature trees providing shade, beauty, & atmosphere. A large covered patio makes it easy to enjoy the outdoors throughout the year, whether dining, entertaining, or simply unwinding. 3 storage sheds & an additional lean-to provide plenty of room for tools, equipment, gardening supplies, & recreational items.

Price just dropped to $550k.  Okay, this one just got a lot sweeter. 

Picture this: two full acres, all yours, completely fenced, flat as a pancake, and zero HOA telling you what you can and can't do with it. That kind of freedom is hard to find out here, and it's exactly what this Sycamore Rocks gem in Apple Valley is offering.

Here's what you're getting: Brand new construction, 4 bedrooms, 2 baths, 1,884 sq ft of bright, open living space
A modern kitchen that's ready for whatever you're cooking up A 2-car garage plus horse-friendly acreage with real room for a barn, an arena, a workshop, or just about anything else you've been dreaming about
And now the best part. 

This isn't just a house. It's the kind of space where your life actually gets to stretch out. Mornings with mountain views stretching across the High Desert. Minutes from Sycamore Rock Park and Granite Hills High School, with easy access to Hwy 18 whenever you need to get moving.

Whether you've been hunting for horse property, craving elbow room, or just want a fresh start without anyone else's rules attached, this one's worth a look.

In reality, homes like this at this price don't come around often in Apple Valley.

results.remarks: Discover a fresh take on modern High Desert living in this exceptional brand-new construction home. Positioned on 1.598 acres with expansive mountain and valley views, this 2,674 sqft residence offers an impressive blend of contemporary design, generous living spaces, and endless possibilities for enjoying the desert lifestyle. The thoughtfully designed floor plan includes 4 bedrooms, a dedicated office, 3.5 bathrooms, and two private primary suites, creating an ideal layout for multigenerational households, guests, or anyone seeking additional space and privacy. Inside, vaulted ceilings, oversized windows, recessed lighting, and abundant natural light give the home an open feel. The heart of the home is the expansive kitchen, featuring warm wood cabinetry, quartz countertops, a large island with built-in sink, walk-in pantry, and ample storage. The light, whitewashed wood look tile flooring creates an organic feel throughout the main living areas, beautifully complementing the natural cabinetry. The primary suite offers a private escape with a dual-sink vanity, luxurious freestanding soaking tub, separate walk-in shower, and expansive walk-in closet. The second primary suite provides additional flexibility with its own private bathroom featuring a walk-in shower and direct access to the covered patio through sliding glass doors. Built-in cabinetry throughout the hallway and half bath adds practical storage while maintaining the home's clean, cohesive aesthetic. At the center of the living space, a dramatic floor to ceiling fireplace finished with sophisticated gray tile makes a bold architectural statement and provides a beautiful gathering point for the living room. Decorative brick detailing on the exterior columns adds dimension and character to the home's modern facade. Step outside beneath the expansive covered patio and enjoy the surrounding mountain and valley views, with nearly 1.6 acres offering plenty of space to bring your vision to life. Create a resort-style pool, workshop, ADU, or your own private desert oasis. The oversized attached three car garage and long driveway provide exceptional parking and storage. Thoughtful amenities include solar, fiber optic readiness, and a pre-installed home security camera system ready for hookup. With open skies, expansive views, and plenty of room to grow, this newly completed home offers a rare opportunity to enjoy the best of new construction without sacrificing space or the beauty of the High Desert.

ABSOLUTELY STUNNING CUSTOM HOME located in the highly desirable DESERT KNOLLS community of Apple Valley! Tucked away in a quiet road on a LARGE LOT, this distinctive architectural residence offers 4 BEDROOMS,  3 BATHROOMS, breathtaking VALLEY VIEWS, and exceptional privacy.

EXTENSIVELY RENOVATED with modern finishes, recent upgrades include FRESH INTERIOR AND EXTERIOR PAINT, refinished cabinetry, LUXURY VINYL PLANK FLOORING throughout, NEW BASEBOARDS, RECESSED LED LIGHTING, and beautifully remodeled bathrooms featuring NEW VANITIES, TOILETS, FIXTURES, AND NEWLY TILED SHOWERS. The kitchen is complete with  BRAND-NEW APPLIANCES, ready for its new owner.

The spacious, OPEN-CONCEPT FLOOR PLAN is filled with natural light and showcases a dramatic SPIRAL STAIRCASE that creates an impressive grand entrance. The luxurious PRIMARY SUITE offers a cozy FIREPLACE, PRIVATE BALCONY with serene desert and valley views, and a beautifully updated en-suite bathroom featuring a FREESTANDING VICTORIAN-STYLE SOAKING TUB that blends timeless elegance with modern finishes.

The thoughtfully designed floor plan features 3 BEDROOMS UPSTAIRS, including the spacious primary suite, while the main level offers an additional BONUS ROOM and a full bathroom with JACK-AND-JILL ACCESS, ideal for guests, multigenerational living, or a private home office.

Step outside to enjoy the EXPANSIVE OUTDOOR SPACE and peaceful surroundings, perfect for entertaining or relaxing while taking in the stunning HIGH DESERT SUNSETS. With PLENTY OF ROOM TO ADD A POOL, you can create the backyard oasis you've always envisioned.

This home offers ample space for RV PARKING, BOATS, AND ALL YOUR RECREATIONAL TOYS. Enjoy convenient access to NEARBY OFF-ROAD TRAILS, making this property ideal for outdoor enthusiasts. Combining luxury, space, privacy, and endless possibilities, this exceptional custom home truly offers it all. 
Additional highlights include a CIRCULAR DRIVEWAY, an OVERSIZED THREE-CAR GARAGE, and a prime location just minutes from LOCAL HOSPITALS, SHOPPING, DINING, and INCREDIBLY CONVENIENT ACCESS TO I-15 Fwy. Another outstanding feature is that this home is connected to PUBLIC SEWER, offering convenience and eliminating the maintenance associated with a septic system.
Located near the highly regarded Lewis Center's AAE (TK–12 Charter School). 
A truly ONE-OF-A-KIND CUSTOM HOME that perfectly combines classic character, modern updates, and an unbeatable location.

results.remarks:
The home you have been looking for is finally here! This beautifully maintained Apple Valley residence sits on a spacious, nearly three quarter acre lot with a set back front yard and a circular driveway that creates instant curb appeal. Masonry style block fencing with integrated lighting adds elegance and nighttime visibility. The fully fenced, level backyard provides ample space for a pool, outdoor living, and entertaining, with convenient rear alley access that is perfect for RVs, trailers, or easy guest entry, adding both convenience and flexibility.

Inside, the home features modern wood look tile flooring, recessed lighting, smart home features, and elegant fandeliers throughout. The bathrooms have been thoughtfully updated with stylish finishes that create a serene, spa like ambiance.

The split floor plan includes an attached garage for easy access, a bonus enclosed sunroom with both interior and backyard access, and an additional multi use bonus area room with interior and private entry that can serve as a home office, guest suite, or fourth bedroom.

Designed for entertaining and comfortable living, the home flows seamlessly to an extra long, two part backyard covered patio that opens at the center to a cozy firepit area, ideal for relaxing evenings under the stars. The cemented, well lit space is perfect for gatherings of any size and provides a private, resort style setting for family and friends.

The tranquil backyard also features a beautifully converted private shed that has been transformed into a glamorous, fully functional retreat with a kitchenette, laundry, and bathroom and sleeping accommodations. This unique space is perfect for hosting guests, private events, or creating a creative studio or personal getaway.

Additional outdoor highlights include several fruit trees, flowering plants, oversized modern planters, and a full irrigation system ready for your landscaping ideas. Upgrades include a premium tankless water heater, a 25-panel solar system installed in 2022 that is through GoodLeap, a smart garage door with camera, and fresh interior and exterior paint. The property is on city sewer and ideally located near schools, shopping, and commuter routes. Bring your RV, enjoy seamless alley access, this home is even ready for your fur babies with a fenced dog run already in place. Experience this serene and stylish oasis designed for modern living and entertaining.

results.remarks: Experience elevated High Desert living in this stunning brand-new construction home in Apple Valley. Set on 1.598 acres with scenic mountain views, this beautifully designed 2,674 sqft home offers the perfect combination of modern comfort, thoughtful design, and room to create the outdoor retreat you've always envisioned. With 4 bedrooms, a dedicated office, and 3.5 bathrooms, the versatile floor plan features 2 spacious primary suites, each with its own private bathroom, making the home ideal for multigenerational living, extended stay guests, or simply enjoying additional privacy and flexibility. The open concept living space is designed for both everyday enjoyment and entertaining, with vaulted ceilings, large windows, recessed lighting, and abundant natural light creating an inviting space. The beautifully appointed kitchen features crisp white cabinetry, quartz countertops, a massive  island with built-in sink, generous storage, and a walk-in pantry. Ceramic wood look tile flooring with sophisticated gray tones extends through the main living areas, creating a clean, contemporary aesthetic, while plush carpeting provides comfort in the bedrooms. The main suite features a dual-sink vanity, luxurious freestanding soaking tub, separate walk-in shower and walk-in closet. The second primary suite includes its own private bathroom with a walk-in shower and direct access to the covered patio through sliding glass doors. A convenient half bath and built-in cabinetry throughout the home provide both functionality and elevated finishing touches. A dramatic floor to ceiling fireplace with warm tan stone creates a striking focal point in the living area, adding character to the interior. Outside, decorative brick accents enhance the home's exterior columns complementing the desert setting. The large covered patio extends the living space outdoors, offering an ideal place to relax and take in the surrounding mountain and valley views. Added features include solar, fiber optic readiness and a pre-installed home security camera system ready for hookup. The oversized attached three-car garage and long driveway provide abundant parking and storage. With nearly 1.6 acres, there is plenty of room for a pool, workshop, ADU, RV accommodations, or custom landscape. Located in a setting surrounded by wide open skies and expansive views, this exceptional new construction home delivers modern luxury, versatile living, and the freedom to make the property uniquely your own.
